categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Cathay Biotech Inc. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of new bio-based materials using synthetic biology and biomanufacturing technologies. Its main products include bio-based long-chain dicarboxylic acids (DC10-DC18), bio-based pentamethylene diamine, bio-based polyamides, and bio-based composite materials such as continuous fiber reinforced thermoplastic composites (Bio-PPA CFRT). The company also develops downstream applications in textiles, engineering plastics, and composite materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced synthetic biology, cell engineering, biochemistry, and polymer materials engineering. It employs gene editing, AI-assisted enzyme design, microbial metabolic pathway engineering, and high-throughput biomanufacturing platforms. Production methods include bio-fermentation for long-chain dicarboxylic acids and pentamethylene diamine, polymerization for bio-based polyamides, and advanced molding processes for composite materials. The company protects its core technologies through patents and trade secrets.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major international chemical and textile companies such as DuPont, Evonik, Arkema, and Novo Nordisk. The end markets served span automotive, electronics, textiles, green building, logistics, new energy equipment, and specialty chemicals. The company also collaborates with downstream partners to develop applications in battery casings, automotive parts, and renewable energy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Jining (Shandong), Wusu (Xinjiang), and Taiyuan (Shanxi), and headquarters in Shanghai. It maintains overseas sales subsidiaries and warehouses in the United States, Europe, and Hong Kong to serve global customers. Its export markets include the US, Europe, and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Cathay Biotech operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the bio-based materials supply chain. It produces key monomers such as long-chain dicarboxylic acids and pentamethylene diamine, polymerizes these into bio-based polyamides, and further processes them into modified polyamides and composite materials. The company controls core raw materials and integrates vertically from monomer production to finished bio-based polymer products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in synthetic biology, biomanufacturing, and polymer chemistry. Key R&D directions include expanding bio-based long-chain dicarboxylic acid varieties, improving fermentation and purification processes, developing bio-based polyamides with differentiated properties, and advancing composite material technologies. It invests in high-throughput and AI-assisted R&D platforms and focuses on sustainable raw materials including agricultural waste valorization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct product sales of bio-based chemicals and materials. The company sells mainly via direct sales to industrial customers, with some sales through non-end trade customers. It also earns licensing income from patents and technology. Sales contracts are recognized at the point of product delivery or upon fulfillment of contractual obligations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a global leading position in bio-based long-chain dicarboxylic acids and bio-based polyamides. Major competitors include traditional chemical companies like Invista, DuPont, BASF, and specialty chemical firms such as Evonik and Arkema. The company differentiates itself through its advanced biomanufacturing technology, integrated supply chain, and focus on sustainable bio-based materials.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.96 billion, a 39.91% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 489 million, up 33.41%. It has total assets of about RMB 19 billion and net assets of RMB 11.5 billion. The company has shown steady growth driven by market expansion and new product commercialization, with significant R&D investment accounting for nearly 8% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Cathay Biotech emphasizes its green, sustainable bio-based materials that reduce carbon emissions and reliance on fossil resources. Its products offer competitive cost, renewable raw materials, recyclability, and superior performance such as high strength, heat resistance, and lightweight properties. The company’s integrated biomanufacturing platform and proprietary technologies enable differentiated products like bio-based polyamides and composites that serve as foundational materials for the low-carbon economy.
